name: weather
title: Weather
description: A slim raised slab with a dot sky sunk into it. The tile (180) is a 21 × 21 sky with the temperature; the large widget (400 × 560) adds the place, the next hours as dot glyphs and seven days as lit dots on one scale. One sky for each weather, drawn for the clock.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/weather.md. SwiftUI: MetalWeather in the MetalUI Swift package.
